svg.text: A combined entrance for overlapping Bundle carriageways
Stored prototype mesh arrays · original paths and IDs · strict circular corners · direct quads
Four exposed round corners: radius 2 m
Four exposed round corners: radius 2 m
720 quads · zero exterior curb height · one connected patch
720 quads · complete dynamic profiles at all four mouths
Six original exterior ends become four physical entrances; Street 800 and its interior Section 301 remain source records.
The base patch stays between 0 and the 8 cm incoming crown. No corner radius or profile rise is reduced.
16 variants pass: control/width edits, unequal widths/crowns, translated datum, reversed storage, R2 and R4.
Standalone prototype: Bundle-body joins, normal addon ownership, Update and furniture integration are still pending.
